report:
Reviewed the complete provider_authority claim, its one ordinary implementation association in sage_ir::tcx, and its sole TODO test metadata_provider_authority. The claim establishes a typed authority boundary: providers may supply owned dependency/compiler facts, but not resolve local syntax, select Sage candidates, prove Sage goals, normalize Sage aliases, or check Sage bodies. The complete TcxDb trait and all its raw payload declarations were inspected, not just the point-marker preview. Definition IDs, crate lookup, module children, names, paths, declaration signatures, predicates, associated items/values, conservative candidate lists, sized/fundamental facts and macro expansion text are owned data (String, Vec, Option, value enums/IDs and recursive Box payloads). No returned payload contains borrowed compiler/Salsa state. No method accepts a Sage local syntax node, checking context, goal, alias-normalization request or body, and no method returns a selected Sage candidate, solver verdict, normalized Sage alias or checked body. RawSelfTypeHead::LocalAdt is merely an outer-shape fact for conservative enumeration; it is not a local semantic checking request. relevant_trait_impls and inherent_method_candidates return collections and completeness, not a choice; associated_type_value returns one definition's declared raw value rather than normalizing a caller's alias. The proc-macro operations accept source/token strings but return expanded text, which is compiler/plugin-owned expansion output rather than local resolution or type-checking. The crate-disambiguator default compares owned external identity facts and canonical_def_path delegates external path lookup; neither introduces semantic authority. All prohibited semantic operations are therefore absent from this typed interface. This is an interface-level source assessment, not a claim that a runtime trace or exhaustive provider implementation audit was performed.

The associated TODO test is an empty function with a specific verification plan: check absence of proof/normalization/selection/local-resolution/body operations and demonstrate that Sage candidate and solver queries execute after metadata is returned. It provides no assertions and was not run as evidence. Its deferral is retained honestly: completing it requires an interface capability check plus production source-backed integration/query observations that distinguish returned raw facts from Sage's own downstream semantic work. Source inspection establishes the present typed restriction, while that end-to-end regression matrix remains deferred under the explicit TODO entry. No ordinary test or N/A entry is being credited. The captured architectural-foundations RFD clarifies the facts-versus-Sage-decisions distinction and the design/review documents clarify that justified TODO evidence remains deferred. No production/test/association changes were necessary, and no behavior tests or build were run for this review-only assignment; executed commands were review start/read/record. No missing implementation obligation was identified in the typed boundary, and no edit is required to preserve the existing explicit test deferral.
